newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai polls to choose 393 members of lower house.
newsitem.headline: Thai polls to choose 393 members of lower house.

text.p: Thais will go the polls on November 17 to choose 393 members of an enlarged lower House of Representatives which has two more politicians than during the previous government, an election commission said on Monday.
The commission said the larger lower house would represent Thailand's increased population which stood at 59.5 million in January 1996.
Under the Thai constitution, each elected member of parliament represents 150,000 Thais.
Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa dissolved his 14-month coalition on Friday after his partners tried to force him to resign.
Political analysts expect the Democrat Party, led by former Prime Minister Chuan Leekpai, to emerge as the biggest bloc in parliament after the polls.
